description: Check an IP against GreyNoise's Community data: whether it is internet background 'noise' (a mass scanner) and, if so, GreyNoise's classification — 'malicious', 'benign' (an identified research scanner such as Shodan, Censys or Modat) or 'unknown' — with its name and when it was last seen. A 'not observed' result means GreyNoise hasn't seen the IP scanning; it is not an endorsement. Often unavailable: GreyNoise's keyless quota is only 25 lookups per week for this whole server, shared by every user — when it is used up the tool says so at once, with when it resets, instead of querying. For a host name, the first resolved IP is used. Read-only.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 45.83.66.10 or example.com

name: ip_reputation
